leaves.label: Pen note opens untouched: no Clear

gwt.given: A worker on the unit walk has pen C2 open; C2 has no pen note.
gwt.then: Pen note opens as before, with Back and its commit in the footer and no Clear, because nothing has been entered.

authority.says: empty what was entered or ticked …; present only while there is something to empty

leaves.label: typing shows Clear in the footer

gwt.given: Pen note is open and empty of edits.
gwt.then: Clear appears in the footer, left of the commit.

authority.says: Clear empties what was entered or ticked … present only when there is something to reset or clear

leaves.label: Back leaves Pen note and keeps the typed draft; nothing saved

gwt.given: Pen note holds "Gate latch loose", not saved.
gwt.then: They are back where they came from, the typed text is kept as a draft and nothing is saved.

authority.says: Back … leaves and returns to where you came from, keeping the draft.

leaves.label: reopening Pen note shows the draft, with Clear

gwt.given: They left Pen note with Back while it held "Gate latch loose".
gwt.then: The field still holds "Gate latch loose" and Clear is in the footer.

authority.says: Back … leaves and returns to where you came from, keeping the draft.

leaves.label: Clear empties Pen note and goes; nothing saved

gwt.given: Pen note was reopened holding the kept draft "Gate latch loose".
gwt.then: The field is back as it opened, Clear disappears and nothing is saved.

authority.says: Clear empties what was entered or ticked … present only when there is something to reset or clear

leaves.label: after Clear, Back and reopen show Pen note as it opened

gwt.given: They cleared the draft on Pen note.
gwt.when: They go Back and open it again.
gwt.then: It opens as it did the first time, with no Clear.

authority.says: Clear empties what was entered or ticked … present only when there is something to reset or clear

leaves.label: the phone's Back keeps the draft like the footer Back

gwt.given: Pen note holds "Gate latch loose", not saved.
gwt.when: They press the phone's own Back.
gwt.then: They are back where they came from and the typed text is kept as a draft.

authority.says: Back … leaves and returns to where you came from, keeping the draft.
Swiping down or tapping the scrim does what Back does.
